brief:
Jerusalem activists and Islamic organizations have warned of extensive incursions and unprecedented rituals targeting Al-Aqsa Mosque during what is known as the Jewish holiday of Sukkot, running from September 26 to October 2, Shehab Wire reported.

The groups cautioned that the period would see a wave of wide-scale breaches of the mosque compound, though they did not specify the nature of the anticipated rituals or provide details on the scale of expected violations.
